title: Valid Word Abbreviation
description: An abbreviation matches a word when each letter matches literally and each positive decimal number skips exactly that many characters. A number cannot start with zero. Given lowercase `word` and an abbreviation containing lowercase letters and digits, return whether it matches the whole word. Input: `word`, `abbr`. Output: true or false.
constraints: word contains lowercase letters; abbr contains lowercase letters and digits
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
